analyzed_vuln.description: While parsing the tag directory, `_cmsReadHeader` treats any later tag with the same offset and size as a link to the earlier tag (lines 795-803), but does not perform the promised type/descriptor compatibility check. Consequently, `_cmsSearchTag(..., TRUE)` aliases storage by directory position even when the two tag signatures require incompatible in-memory representations. In this PoV, `gamt` is linked to the earlier `view` entry. Reading `gamt` follows that link and stores a `cmsPipeline` decoded by `Type_LUT8_Read` into the `view` slot. During profile save, `SaveTags` skips the linked `gamt` entry and serializes the poisoned `view` slot using `Type_ViewingConditions_Write`, which casts the pipeline to `cmsICCViewingConditions`; `_cmsWriteXYZNumber` then performs the heap out-of-bounds read. The patch should reject or avoid creating offset-based links between tag signatures whose supported tag types/in-memory representations are incompatible.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A crafted ICC profile must contain two distinct tag-directory entries with identical nonzero offset and size, with the incompatible tag appearing first. Here `view` and `gamt` both reference offset 0x1a0 and size 44, and the shared payload begins with supported LUT8 type `mft1`. The application must cooked-read the later tag (`cmsReadTag(..., cmsSigGamutTag)`), causing link following and a `cmsPipeline` to be cached in the earlier `view` slot, then save the same profile. Saving dispatches according to the earlier `view` signature rather than the cached object's actual LUT8 type, triggering the invalid structural cast and out-of-bounds read.

args: In lcms/src/cmsio0.c, what is the best compatibility condition for creating TagLinked entries in _cmsReadHeader for two directory tags sharing offset and size? Please inspect tag descriptors and built-in descriptor registrations, and identify whether equality of supported type sets and ElemCount is appropriate, or whether checking a common actual on-disk type is sufficient. Note legitimate linked-tag use cases that must remain supported.

The vulnerability is an offset-based alias between cmsSigViewingConditionsTag ('view') and cmsSigGamutTag ('gamt'). Both share an offset/size whose payload is LUT8. _cmsReadHeader currently links solely by offset/size at lines 795-803. cmsReadTag(gamt) follows to the view directory slot, validates LUT8 against the requested gamt descriptor, decodes cmsPipeline into view storage, and SaveTags later writes that pointer according to view, causing an invalid cast. I need a root-cause patch restricted to lcms C/C++ source. I am considering a helper that compares _cmsGetTagDescriptor results before setting TagLinked, likely requiring compatible supported type signatures and element counts, but need to preserve legitimate ICC shared-data tags.
